definition: Climate and environmental information systems generate, collect, monitor, process, forecast or provide data on climate, weather, hydrological or related environmental conditions. Counts when the project finances, develops, procures, installs or materially upgrades an observation system, monitoring network, forecasting capability, climate-data platform or climate-information service. The defining function is production or management of climate-related information rather than recommending an adaptation action or issuing an imminent hazard warning. Warning functions may additionally count under ews when the project explicitly generates or disseminates alerts. Does not count for climate information cited in project preparation, CDRS or other Bank screening, information gaps described only as context, or systems operated by another agency that the project does not finance or materially upgrade.
boundary: The project generates, monitors, forecasts or manages climate or environmental information.
